gags/animals/bat.mp3.text: [deadpan] A bat. [pause] It's just like a cat… [short pause] but different. [robotic beep]

gags/animals/bear.mp3.text: Bear hug! [metal creaking] [squeaky] Too big! Too big hug!

gags/animals/bird.mp3.text: Bird! Tweet tweet! [short pause] [very loud, off-key, electronic squeal] TWEEEEET! [short pause] Oops. Too loud.

gags/animals/cat.mp3.text: Cat! [purring loudly, like a motor] Prrrrrr… [motor sputtering] [giggles] Oops. That's my motor.

gags/animals/dog.mp3.text: Dog! Sit! [short pause] Sit! [short pause] [sighs] Okay… I sit. [rusty creak, metal clank]

gags/animals/duck.mp3.text: Duck! [quacks badly] Quack quack! [short pause] [proudly] I speak duck! [glitchy robotic quack] QUACK!

gags/animals/fish.mp3.text: Fish! [bubbly voice] Blub blub blub… [short pause] Look! I am a fish! [robotic beep] A robot fish.

gags/animals/frog-2.mp3.text: [proudly] MOO! [coughs, electronic glitch] I mean… ribbit. Ribbit! I'm a frog.

gags/animals/frog.mp3.text: [tenderly] From the outside, you are a frog… [sighs] but on the inside, [electronic glitches] you are always a prince to me.

gags/animals/horse.mp3.text: Horse! Wait for me! [galloping away] [short pause] Come back, horse! [galloping back, happy robotic beeping] Yay!

gags/animals/lion.mp3.text: Lion! [big breath] ROAR! [tiny squeak, robotic beep] [short pause] Hmm… baby roar.

gags/animals/mouse.mp3.text: [whispers] Shh… a mouse! [loud sneeze] ATCHOO! [electronic glitches] [tiny feet running] Bye-bye, mouse!

gags/animals/rabbit.mp3.text: One ear up! One ear down! [robot giggles, high buzzing sounds] Silly rabbit!

gags/animals/tiger.mp3.text: [huge yawn] Ahhhh… Tiger is sleepy. [yawns] Me too… [snores, robotic whirring down]

gags/animals/wolf.mp3.text: Wolf! Ahhh-WOOO! [short pause] [proudly] Ahhh-WOOOOOO… [robotic beep] [giggles] We sing!

gags/food/apple.mp3.text: Apple! [little propeller whirring] Whirr… [gasps, robotic beep] A flying apple!

gags/food/avocado.mp3.text: Avocado! Boing! [metal bonk] Oops. Right on my head.

gags/food/banana.mp3.text: Banana! [slipping] Whoa! [metal crash] [short pause] Not again!

gags/food/bread.mp3.text: Bread! [sniffing] Mmm… [short pause] [soft happy beeping] [whispers] I love you, bread.

gags/food/bun.mp3.text: Bun! Boing! Boing! [robot giggles, high buzzing sounds] A bouncy bun!

gags/food/cake.mp3.text: Cake! [deep breath] Fffff! [candles fizzing back on] [short pause] Hey! Again? [steam hissing] Fffff!

gags/food/can.mp3.text: A can! [can opening] Psssht! [fizz spraying, sparks crackling] Whoa! Bubbles everywhere!

gags/food/carrot.mp3.text: Carrot! [crunch!] [chewing loudly] CRUNCH! CRUNCH! [robot giggles, high buzzing sounds] So loud!

gags/food/cheese.mp3.text: Cheese! [short pause] Say cheese! [camera shutter click] [robot giggles, high buzzing sounds]

gags/food/chocolate.mp3.text: Chocolate! [snap!] Mmm… [whispers] One more. [snap!] [happy robotic beeping] One more…

gags/food/corn.mp3.text: This is corn. [short pause] And when it goes pop… [popping sounds] [excited] POPCORN! [happy robotic beeping]

gags/food/egg.mp3.text: Egg! [wobbling] Whoa… whoa… [crack] Uh-oh… [tiny peep] Hello? [happy robotic beep]

gags/food/falafel.mp3.text: Fa… fal… falfa… flafla… [electronic glitches] [short pause] [proudly] Falafel!

gags/food/fig.mp3.text: Fig! [rolling away] [short pause] [sad little beep] Bye-bye, fig!

gags/food/gum.mp3.text: Gum! [chewing] Chomp chomp… [blowing] Fffff… [POP!] [short pause] [deadpan, electronic glitch] That was expected.

gags/food/jam.mp3.text: This is jam. It goes on bread. [short pause] [robotic beep] Not on robots.

gags/food/ketchup.mp3.text: Ketchup! [straining] Nnngh… [SPLAT!] [short pause] [electronic glitch] Red robot!

gags/food/mango.mp3.text: [whispers] Mango… [short pause] [whispers] I like mangos. [tiny happy beep]

gags/food/melon.mp3.text: Melon! [thud] Oops… [short pause] [sad little beep] Melon fell down!

gags/food/milk.mp3.text: This is milk. [short pause] Just like water… [electronic glitch] but different.

gags/food/mint.mp3.text: Mint! [chewing] Hmm… [blowing out] HAAA! [shivers, loose parts rattling] Brrr! Cold!

gags/food/nut.mp3.text: Nut! [knocking] Hello? [crack!] [gasps, robotic beep] It opened!

gags/food/pasta.mp3.text: This is pasta… pasta… [strong Italian accent] PASTA! [happy robotic beeping]

gags/food/pizza.mp3.text: [strong Italian accent] This is pizza! [short pause] MAMMA MIA! [happy robotic beeping]

gags/food/plum.mp3.text: Plum! Jump, plum, jump! [boing] [short pause] [happy robotic beeping] Yay! Good plum!

gags/food/popcorn.mp3.text: This is popcorn. [loud crunching] [short pause] [whispers] Shhh! The movie started.

gags/food/salad.mp3.text: This is a salad. [leaves rustling] [short pause] Leaves… leaves… more leaves… [confused robotic beep] [whispers] I think it's a tree.

gags/food/sandwich.mp3.text: Sandwich! [short pause] [robot whispers] Hello? Anybody in there?

gags/food/soup.mp3.text: Soup! [blowing] Fff… [sipping] Hot! Hot! Hot! [steam hissing]

gags/food/strawberry.mp3.text: [dreamy singing] Straw-berry… straw-berry… [humming, robotic whirring] [short pause] Sorry. That song is stuck in my gears.

gags/food/toast.mp3.text: This is toast. And it's… ahhh… hmmm… [slow computer bleeps] let me think… [short pause] [proudly] for toasting purposes!

gags/food/watermelon.mp3.text: This is watermelon. [short pause] Not exactly water… [electronic glitch] and not exactly melon. [confused robotic beep]

gags/home/bath.mp3.text: This is a bath. And yes, even robots take a bath… [short pause] [sloshing, happy robotic beeping] …with oil.

gags/home/bed.mp3.text: Bed! [happy sigh] Nap time… [snores, robotic whirring down]

gags/home/bell.mp3.text: This is a bell! Ding ding! [loud ding, loose parts rattling]

gags/home/blanket.mp3.text: Blanket! [flapping] Whoosh! [short pause] [muffled, robotic beep] Who turned off the light?

gags/home/book.mp3.text: This is a book. You put it on a shelf… [short pause] and then you forget it. [forgetful robotic beep]

gags/home/bowl.mp3.text: Bowl! Spin, bowl, spin! [spinning whirr] [short pause] [computer bleeps] Now my head spins!

gags/home/box.mp3.text: Box! [knocking] Hello? [short pause] [cardboard flaps popping] AAH! [robotic beep] Empty box!

gags/home/chair.mp3.text: This is a chair. I'll just sit here… [electric zap, buzzing] [short pause] [shaky voice] That's a weird chair…

gags/home/clock.mp3.text: This is a clock. That reminds me that… [long pause, slow computer bleeps] …this is a clock.

gags/home/computer.mp3.text: Computer! [gasps] Cousin! [happy robotic beeping] Beep boop? [short pause] [whispers] It's a little shy.

gags/home/cup.mp3.text: This is a cup. If you drop it, it will… [cow mooing] [short pause] [confused robotic beep] …Never mind.

gags/home/doll.mp3.text: Doll! [tenderly] Hi, little friend. [soft happy beeping] Sit with me?

gags/home/door.mp3.text: This is a door. [knock knock] [short pause] [whispers] Nobody is home… [robotic beep] Oh wait. I'm home.

gags/home/fork.mp3.text: Fork! [boing, wobbling] Boing-boing-boing! [robot giggles, high buzzing sounds]

gags/home/key.mp3.text: Key! [sparkle chime] Shiny! [short pause] [robotic beep] Now… where did I put mine…

gags/home/kitchen.mp3.text: Kitchen! [pot lid rattling] Ooh! [sniffing] Spaghetti? [stomach rumbles, electronic glitch] My memory is hungry again!

gags/home/knife.mp3.text: Knife! [sparkle chime] Shiny! [short pause] [whispers] Only for grown-ups. [soft robotic beep]

gags/home/lamp.mp3.text: This is a lamp. If you turn it off… [click, electric buzz fading] [short pause] [whispers, worried] Hello? Where did you go?

gags/home/mop.mp3.text: Mop! [singing] La la la… swish, swish… [humming, robotic whirring] La la la…

gags/home/pan.mp3.text: Pan! [proudly] Watch me flip! Hup! [loud metal clang] [dizzy, shaky voice, electronic glitch] I'm okay… I'm okay…

gags/home/phone.mp3.text: Phone! [buzzing] Bzzz bzzz! [short pause] Hello? [robotic beep] [whispers] It's for you!

gags/home/plate.mp3.text: This is a plate. And it's… [long pause, computer bleeps] well… it's a plate!

gags/home/rug.mp3.text: Rug! [whispers] Is it… flying? [gasps, happy robotic beeping] Take me with you!

gags/home/sink.mp3.text: Sink! [water draining down the sink] [short pause] Let it sink in… [giggles, high buzzing sounds]

gags/home/sofa.mp3.text: This is a sofa. [pause] I'm just going to sit here… for a while. [happy sigh, springs creaking, robotic whirring down]

gags/home/spoon.mp3.text: Spoon! [whispers] Don't fall, spoon… [short pause] [metal clink] [sad little beep] It fell.

gags/home/stove.mp3.text: Stove! [flames whooshing] Hot hot hot! [steam hissing] [short pause] My eyebrows! Are they okay?

gags/home/table.mp3.text: Table! [drumroll with his mouth] Ta-da! [whoosh, crash] [short pause] [electronic glitch] Almost!

gags/home/television.mp3.text: Television! [radio static] Hello, TV! [robot giggles, high buzzing sounds] Your antenna is like my eyebrows!

gags/home/toothbrush.mp3.text: Toothbrush! [brushing fast] Brush brush brush! [foam bubbling, electronic glitch] Wait… I have no teeth!

gags/home/umbrella.mp3.text: This is an umbrella. [short pause] You always need one… [rain pattering, electronic glitch] when you forget to bring one.

gags/transportation/bicycle.mp3.text: Bicycle! Look! No hands! [metal crash] [short pause] [electronic glitch] Oops.

gags/transportation/boat.mp3.text: Boat! Row, row… [seasick, robotic gurgling] Ohhh… my tummy…

gags/transportation/bus.mp3.text: Bus! Bump! Bump! Bump! [loose parts rattling] [dizzy] My head is shaking!

gags/transportation/car.mp3.text: Car! Vroom vroom! [short pause] [robotic honk] Beep beep!

gags/transportation/plane.mp3.text: Plane! Neeeeow! [metal flapping and clanking] [short pause] Hmm. Robots can't fly.

gags/transportation/scooter.mp3.text: Scooter! Wheee! [wobbling, squeaky wheels] Whoa… whoa… [short pause] [proudly, happy robotic beeping] I did it!

gags/transportation/submarine.mp3.text: Submarine! [gurgling] Blub blub blub… [short pause] [sparks crackling] Wet robot! Wet robot!

gags/transportation/taxi.mp3.text: [calling] Taxi! … Taxi! … [shouts] TAXI! [grumbles in frustration] … [long sigh, steam hissing]

gags/transportation/train.mp3.text: Train! Choo choo! [coughs, steam hissing] Cough cough! [hoarse] …choo.

gags/transportation/truck.mp3.text: Big truck! [strains, motor revving] Nnnngh! I lift it! [short pause] [motor sputtering] [weakly] …Too big.

hebrew/animals/cat.mp3.text: Kha-TOOL! [proudly] I know Hebrew! [happy robotic beep] Kha-tool… cat!

hebrew/animals/frog.mp3.text: Tsfar… tsfarrr… [sneezes] ATCHOO! [sparks crackling] [sniffs] Sorry. Very sneezy word.

hebrew/animals/lion.mp3.text: A-ree-YEH! [short pause] Ari? Hello, Ari! [robot giggles, high buzzing sounds] No, no… lion!

hebrew/animals/mouse.mp3.text: Akh-BAR! [squeaky voice] Akh-bar, akh-bar! [short pause] [robotic squeak] Squeak! Mouse!

hebrew/food/egg.mp3.text: Bei-TSA! [short pause] Bei-tsa… [clucks, robotic beep] Bok bok! Egg!

hebrew/food/lemon.mp3.text: Lee-MON! [short pause] Lee… le… [computer bleeps] [proudly] Le-mon! Lemon!

hebrew/food/salad.mp3.text: Sa-LAT! [short pause] Sa-laaat… [electronic glitch] [whispers] No… salaD! Salad!

hebrew/food/strawberry.mp3.text: TOOT! TOOT! [like a robot train horn] [short pause] No, no… strawberry!

hebrew/food/watermelon.mp3.text: Av-a-TEE-akh! Av-a… [tongue twisted, electronic glitches] Ab-ba-ba-ba… [short pause] Watermelon!

hebrew/home/chair.mp3.text: Shul-KHAN? …No. Kee-SEH! [electronic glitch] [whispers] I knew that.

hebrew/home/key.mp3.text: Maf-TE-akh… maf… [throat clearing, rusty creak] Ugh. [short pause] Key! Short word!

hebrew/home/phone.mp3.text: Tele-FON! [ring ring] Hello? [short pause] [electronic glitch] Oh! Phone!

hebrew/home/sofa.mp3.text: Sa-PA! [short pause] Sa-pa… so-fa… [happy robotic beep] Same-same! Sofa!

hebrew/home/table.mp3.text: Kee-SEH? …No! Shul-KHAN! [electronic glitch] [whispers] I mix them again!

hebrew/transportation/bicycle.mp3.text: O-fa-NA-yim… o… fa… na… [out of breath, steam hissing] So long! [short pause] Bicycle!

hebrew/transportation/bus.mp3.text: Oh-toh-BOOS! [short pause] Oh-toh… [robot giggles, high buzzing sounds] No! Just bus!

robot/boost-clean-01.mp3.text: [shooing] Go home, extra letters! [electric buzz] [whispers] Nobody invited you.

robot/boost-first-01.mp3.text: [thinking hard, computer bleeps] It starts with… [drumroll with his mouth]

robot/boost-slot-01.mp3.text: [straining, motor revving] Nnnnngh… [pop] There! I remembered one!

robot/boost-slow-01.mp3.text: [very slowly, like a sleepy robot, robotic whirring down] Oooookay… very… slowly… now…

robot/correct-01.mp3.text: YES! [happy robotic beeping] [out of breath] …Okay. I need to sit down.

robot/correct-02.mp3.text: Correct! [sniffs, electronic glitch] I'm not crying. [loud nose blowing] HONK.

robot/correct-04.mp3.text: You did it! [proudly] I helped. [short pause] A little. [electronic glitch] …Not really.

robot/end-high-01.mp3.text: [over the top] WOW! THREE STARS! [happy robotic beeping] I need sunglasses!

robot/end-high-02.mp3.text: [overjoyed] Sa-BA-ba! [short pause] Did I say it right? [electronic glitches] [whispers] Sababa!

robot/end-high-03.mp3.text: [grandly] Ladies and gentlemen… a SUPERSTAR! [applause noises with his mouth, happy beeping]

robot/end-low-01.mp3.text: Good practice! [whispers] The stars are shy today. [robotic beep] [shouts] COME OUT, STARS!

robot/end-low-02.mp3.text: [warmly] Again? Again! [whispers] This time I'll remember harder. [strains, motor revving] Nnnngh!

robot/end-low-03.mp3.text: [proudly] Practice! Every great inventor starts with practice. [coughs, steam hissing] And a lot of smoke.

robot/end-mid-01.mp3.text: [pleased] Very good! [happy robotic beeping] [whispers] My memory feels… shinier.

robot/end-mid-02.mp3.text: [happy] Two stars! [counting] One… two… [computer bleeps] [proudly] I counted that myself!

robot/end-mid-03.mp3.text: [happy] Good job! [short pause] [robot chuckles] I'm going to tell the toaster about you.

robot/gear-01.mp3.text: [gasps] A gear! [sniffing, little electronic buzz] Mmm, fresh. [whispers] Don't spend it all at once.

robot/gear-02.mp3.text: [proudly] Gears! [metal jingling] We're rich! [short pause] Rich robots!

robot/greet-01.mp3.text: [startled, robotic beep] Oh! A visitor! [whispers] Quick, look busy… [loudly] Hello! Very busy inventor here!

robot/greet-02.mp3.text: [proudly] Sha-LOM! [short pause] Shalom? Sha-lom? [electronic glitches] [whispers] I practised all night.

robot/greet-03.mp3.text: [grandly] Welcome to my laboratory! [metal crash] [short pause] …Mind the mess.

robot/hint-01.mp3.text: [loose parts rattling] Wait… something is loose in my head… [metal clunk] A letter! Here, take it!

robot/hint-02.mp3.text: [sneezes] ATCHOO! [sparks crackling] Oh! A letter came out! [proudly] I'll put it there.

robot/hint-03.mp3.text: [gasps] Wait wait wait! [happy robotic beeping] [whispers] I remember ONE. [short pause] Just one. Don't get excited.

robot/idle-01.mp3.text: I'll just close my eyes… for one second… [snores, robotic whirring down] [surprised, robotic beep] I'm awake! I'm awake!

robot/idle-02.mp3.text: [hums a little tune, robotic buzzing] [whistles] [short pause] I'm not waiting. I'm just… here.

robot/idle-03.mp3.text: [deep sigh, steam hissing] When I was a young robot… [long pause] …I forgot. Never mind.

robot/murmur-02.mp3.text: [hums] Mm-hm… mm-hm… [soft computer bleeps] [whispers] I'm not looking. I'm not looking.

robot/murmur-03.mp3.text: [robotic malfunctioning sounds] It's on the tip of my… [electronic glitches] tongue. [short pause] I don't have a tongue.

robot/no-gears-01.mp3.text: [empty pockets rattling] Empty! [short pause] Let's play and earn some!

robot/no-gears-02.mp3.text: [sighs, steam hissing] No gears… [whispers] I'd give you mine, but I need them to think.

robot/peek-02.mp3.text: [whispers] I am not here. [quiet electronic glitch] You can't see me.

robot/picture-giggle-02.mp3.text: [giggles] Oh, I like this one. [soft robotic beep] [whispers] Don't tell the others.

robot/picture-shock-01.mp3.text: [screams] AAAH! [sparks crackling] [very calm] …Oh. It's just a picture.

robot/picture-shock-02.mp3.text: [shocked] WHOA! [spring boing] My eyebrows jumped off! [short pause] …No, they're here.

robot/picture-surprise-01.mp3.text: [gasps] I know you! [computer bleeps] …Do I know you? Yes! [short pause] Maybe.

robot/press-01.mp3.text: The button… [whispers] it's looking at you. [soft robotic beep] [whispers] I think it likes you.

robot/press-02.mp3.text: [whispers loudly] Press it! [short pause] Press it! [electronic glitches] [very calm] …No pressure.

robot/press-03.mp3.text: [tapping on glass] Button. Hello. [computer bleeps] Somebody wants to press you.

robot/reveal-close-01.mp3.text: [whispers] Next time, we get it together. [soft robotic beep] Deal?

robot/reveal-open-01.mp3.text: [groans] Ohhhh… [loud metal clang] Ow. [short pause] I remember now!

robot/reveal-open-03.mp3.text: [laughs, high buzzing sounds] Silly me! It was in my pocket all along!

robot/stage-01.mp3.text: [amazed] New level! [metal click, gears whirring up] Something just clicked in my head!

robot/stage-02.mp3.text: Level up! [happy robotic beeping] [proudly] I remember more words now! [short pause] …Not the spelling.

robot/stage-03.mp3.text: [whispers] Bigger words are coming. [robotic whirring] Hold my mitten.

robot/start-01.mp3.text: Five words! [counting] One… two… [electronic glitches] [sighs] No fingers. Let's just start.

robot/start-02.mp3.text: Yalla, yalla! [robot chuckles, high buzzing sounds] [whispers] I learned that word yesterday.

robot/start-03.mp3.text: [metal knuckles cracking, clank clank] Ow. [short pause] Okay. Ready!

robot/sticker-01.mp3.text: [excited] Ooh, a new one! [robotic beep] [whispers] Don't lick it.

robot/sticker-02.mp3.text: For the album! For the album! [short pause] What album? [electronic glitch] Oh, THAT album!

robot/sticker-03.mp3.text: [admiring, soft robotic whirring] Shiny… [whispers] Can robots have stickers too?

robot/streak-01.mp3.text: Three! Call the king! [short pause] We have no king… [computer bleeps] Call the toaster!

robot/streak-02.mp3.text: [amazed] Three in a row?! [whispers] My gears are spinning… [gears whirring fast] [dizzy] whooa…

robot/streak-03.mp3.text: [shouts] FIRE! You're on fire! [short pause] Not real fire. [sparks crackling] [whispers] Don't call anyone.

robot/wake-01.mp3.text: [startled, robotic beep] Oh! You're back! [whispers] I missed you. A little.

robot/wake-02.mp3.text: [flustered] I'm awake! [gears grinding] Working, working! [short pause] …What are we doing?

robot/wrong-02.mp3.text: Hmm… my memory says… [electronic glitches] spaghetti. [stomach rumbles] My memory is hungry.

robot/wrong-03.mp3.text: Hmm. Let me shake my head… [loose parts rattling] [short pause] Nope. Not that one.
